input.command: cd D:\pal; try { $h = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8082/health' -TimeoutSec 10; "HEALTH => $($h | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)" } catch { "HEALTH FAILED => $($_.Exception.Message)" }; try { $o = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8082/api/v1/openapi.json' -TimeoutSec 15; "OPENAPI paths => $($o.paths.Count)"; ($o.paths.PSObject.Properties.Name | Where-Object { $_ -match 'tally' }) -join ', ' } catch { "OPENAPI FAILED => $($_.Exception.Message)" }
